title: GatewaySshKeysUsed
description: When each paired SSH key was last used, kept by the gateway in its state directory (`ssh/keys-used.json`) and read by `devbox ssh keys`.

keys.description: One entry per key that has been used.

SshKeyUse.description: The last use of one key.

fingerprint.description: The key's fingerprint, as `ssh-keygen -l` prints it (`SHA256:…`).

at.description: When it last authenticated a connection (Unix time, ms).
